original_test_intent: Exercise all approved fabric links under traffic, reset the test interval's PHY information, collect a fresh 10-15-minute PHY dataset and verify ibdiagnet reports no unacceptable BER or major errors.
original_method: Confirm UFM/IBDiagnet versions and port inventory; export existing counters/PHY data first; approve all-port scope; start bounded ib_write_bw; run the release-verified --pc/--reset_phy_info action once; record reset completion; collect exactly timed traffic/telemetry; run --get_phy_info; preserve complete output directory; parse per-port Symbol BER, Effective BER and major warnings against numeric/link-specific policy; stop traffic and verify fabric health.
manual_activity: Fabric owner authorizes the all-port diagnostic reset/window and adjudicates link warnings; operator remains available for physical correlation/recovery.
safety_requirements: Never rerun reset automatically or clear logs

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic ibdiagnet access is incomplete and subnet-merger warning is unrelated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use UFM's generated, release-verified --pc/--reset_phy_info command once after baseline export, then --get_phy_info after the approved interval; retain raw command text and logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: --pc, --reset_phy_info, 10-15 minutes, --get_phy_info, ibdiagnet2.log and BER checks retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the reset as the measurement epoch boundary and map every post-epoch PHY result to a known port/cable and concurrent traffic interval.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds pre-reset preservation, exact scope/command preview, numeric error policy and post-health.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic fabric diagnostics cannot substitute for the reset-then-measure BER sequence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Resetting PHY information destroys historical comparison; all-port load/reset can obscure a localized issue if identities and timings are not retained.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines whether Symbol/Effective BER must be zero or below vendor thresholds, which warnings are major, how unavailable ports are handled and exact wait start/end events.
expected_evidence: Complete ibdiagnet2.log and per-port BER/error table

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row426 Wistron-L12 Cluster-00008-V002: approve UFM/IBDiagnet versions and generated command, all-port GUID scope, pre-reset archive, finite ib_write_bw profile, exact 10-15-minute epoch, per-port Symbol/Effective BER and major-warning policy, storage and post-health stops.

review_improvement: Makes the PHY reset an explicit one-way epoch boundary and preserves the data required to interpret every new BER result.
independent_technical_reasoning: Without a pre-reset archive, a clean post-reset value may only show that history was erased. The acceptance must bind the reset time, sustained traffic interval and per-port result so an unused or misidentified port cannot appear falsely healthy.
